d.t: A figure or mark in the shape of the letter Y.
A Y-shaped object, such as a railroad fork or a support for a telescope; a wye, a bifurcation.
A moth of the genus Plusia, having markings resembling the letter Y.
A particular facility run by the YMCA/YWCA.
d.e: Of course, the audience up here at the Bronx “Y” will probably be a little parochial, but if I make good in the lecture, I might one day end up speaking down at the Lex. Ave. “Y” where great thinkers like Norman Mailer and Seymour Krim are always airing their views.
